# resolume-mcp

Resolume Arena VJ software control via Open Sound Control. 6 MCP tools for live video mixing, clip management, and real-time performance.

## Quick Info
- Entry point: `python -m resolume_mcp`
- Backend port: 10771
- Frontend port: 10770
- OSC ports: 7000 (in), 7001 (out)

## Tools
- help: Multilevel help system
- status: System diagnostics
- clip_control: Video clip loading, playback, manipulation
- layer_control: Layer opacity, blending, transitions
- effect_control: Effect parameter control
- performance_control: BPM sync, batch operations

For comprehensive reference see `docs/development/DEVELOPMENT_GUIDE.md` and `docs/user-guide/`.
